entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Oh... [fName]-kun. I'm glad I got[n]to see you.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: On that note, I have a small gift for[n]the occasion, if you'll accept it...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Apparently these days, people give[n]chocolate to friends, even when it's[n]purely platonic.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: It seems like a fine opportunity to[n]celebrate your return, and express[n]my gratitude.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I hope shogi brings us even closer[n]together.
